messages:
Alice K: Quick heads-up — planning to cut the release branch for v1.12 tomorrow at 14:00 PT. Please get version bumps, changelog entries, and any backport requests in by EOD today.

Ben M: Got it. Is the branch name going to be release/1.12 or release/v1.12?

Alice K: release/1.12 (no leading v). We standardized that last cycle.

Carol S: Any rules on which commits are eligible for backport? Small fixes only, or behavior changes ok?

Alice K: Policy reminder: only bugfixes and docs. No feature additions unless they are tiny and risk-reviewed. Use the label `pr/backport-request` and include the original PR number.

Dave L: For cherry-picks, should I open a PR against release/1.12 with the same title prefixed `cherry-pick:` ?

Emma R: We prefer `cherry-pick: <orig-title> (#<orig-pr>)` in the title and add `cherry-pick` + `release/1.12` labels. Add a short note in the PR body why it's safe.

Ben M: Does anyone have a one-liner for the changelog entry format? I have a few small fixes.

Carol S: mvn: bump dependency X -> Y, fixes missing null-check in parser. (internal)

Alice K: Changelog format: one-line summary, component prefix in brackets, and a link to the PR. Example: `[runtime] Fix null-check in parser — #3421`

release-bot: Branch `release/1.12` created by @Alice K at 2026-02-28T21:00:04Z :branch:

Dave L: I'll start cherry-picking the diagnostics PRs. Ping me if you want me to include anything else.

Emma R: Thanks — I'm queuing two backports and tagging them now.

Ben M: quick question — if a backport fails due to conflicts, should we escalate or drop?

Alice K: Try a manual rebase, if it's >15min of work or touches multiple subsystems escalate to #eng-oncall for advice. Otherwise skip.

Carol S: :thumbsup:

Alice K: Also reminder: cut-off for merging into release/1.12 is 13:30 PT tomorrow (30m before cut). Anything after that must go to next release unless critical.

Ben M: noted, will prioritize changelogs.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: branch-cut checklist at 13:00 PT tomorrow. (automated)

Alice K: Thanks everyone. If you run into any blockers drop a note here or DM me directly.
